test_only_reason: No implementation change: evaluate already behaves as specified. check_counts and the growth test asserted SSSP_COUNT counters unconditionally; with SSSP_DIAGNOSTICS=OFF (ci-release, release) every eval_* counter is 0, so the upper bounds, eval_interval_splits == eval_sfm_splits and the scans/N, failed/N growth checks passed vacuously and the Release build checked nothing about the visit accounting. The fix guards the counter assertions and adds hook/result-based checks (scans, opens, emissions, relaxations, supplemental offers, retirements) that hold in every build. The tests pass against the current implementation, so a RED event would need a manufactured break (docs/tdd/README.md forbids it); the new checks were instead shown to detect injected defects in a diagnostics-OFF build of an out-of-tree copy, reported to the lead.
spec: The Lemma 4.7 evaluate property tests check something in every build: counter assertions run only when SSSP_DIAGNOSTICS is on, and the bounds that can be observed are checked from EvalHooks tallies and the returned EvalResult in every build
